answer: Ephemeral Answer Commitment (EAC): each admission request gets a verifier challenge derived from a secret juniper seed plus live inlet entropy. The agent must forge a task-specific answer and nonce whose hash meets a difficulty target; the answer hash is recorded as spent. A valid answer yields a one-time capability key, so it cannot be copied to another identity or replayed. Cost: an attacker pays fresh compute and entropy per sybil, linearly, with no reusable credential.
